citations.narrative:
There were sharp points present in two separate enclosures.
- In the outdoor run portion of a kennel housing two dogs, there was a section of twisted wire attached to a support pole,
extending into the enclosure. This point is located at eye level to the enclosed dogs and could cause injury.
- In an outdoor enclosure housing two dogs, the shelter access door is surrounded by woven wire. This wire is loose
around the entrance door and has multiple sharp points. This is a potential source of injury and/or entrapment to the dogs.
Sharp points and edges are a potential source of injury to the enclosed dogs. The sharp points should be removed or
repaired by the facility to help ensure the welfare of the enclosed animals.
Correct by: 6 September 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with licensee.
